description: Add, update, or remove a bridge VLAN table entry (interface/bridge/vlan): which ports carry which VLANs tagged or untagged. Idempotent by bridge + vlanIds, compared as a set of ids (10,20 equals 20,10; 100-102 equals 100,101,102) with port lists compared order-insensitively: add returns already_exists when an equal entry exists and CONFLICT when it exists with different ports or overlaps another entry's VLANs; update returns no_change when nothing differs; update and remove return NOT_FOUND when no static entry has exactly those VLANs. Dynamic entries (created by RouterOS from PVIDs) are refused. A port listed as both tagged and untagged is rejected. Results warn when the bridge has vlan-filtering off (the entry has no effect until it is on) and when a change drops the bridge itself from a VLAN while filtering is on. Workflow: create the VLAN entries, set access-port PVIDs with manage_bridge_port, then enable vlan-filtering with manage_bridge last.

confirmationToken.description: Token from a prior APPROVAL_REQUIRED response. Re-submit the identical call with this token to confirm the destructive action.

disabled.description: Whether the entry is disabled (unchanged on update when omitted)

routerId.description: Router ID; omit to use the default router.

tagged.description: Interfaces that carry these VLANs tagged (trunks). Include the bridge itself when the router has a VLAN interface on it. On update, replaces the list; [] clears it

untagged.description: Interfaces that carry these VLANs untagged (access ports; set their PVID to match with manage_bridge_port). On update, replaces the list; [] clears it

vlanIds.description: VLAN id (1-4094), range (100-110) or comma list (10,20,100-110). With bridge, the idempotency key; order and format do not matter (20,10 equals 10,20)

name: manage_bridge_vlan
title: Manage Bridge VLAN
